scripts.deploy:local: export $(grep -v '^#' .env.local | xargs) && cd packages/contracts && forge script script/Deploy.s.sol:Deploy --rpc-url localhost:8545 --private-key 0xac0974bec39a17e36ba4a6b4d238ff944bacb478cbed5efcae784d7bf4f2ff80 --broadcast -vvvv
scripts.deploy:sepolia: export $(grep -v '^#' .env | xargs) && cd packages/contracts && forge clean && forge script script/Deploy.s.sol:Deploy --rpc-url https://ethereum-sepolia-rpc.publicnode.com --private-key $PRIVATE_KEY --broadcast --verify --etherscan-api-key $ETHERSCAN_API_KEY -vvvv
scripts.verify:sepolia: export $(grep -v '^#' .env | xargs) && cd packages/contracts && forge verify-contract --rpc-url https://ethereum-sepolia-rpc.publicnode.com --chain-id 11155111 --etherscan-api-key $ETHERSCAN_API_KEY --watch 0xa65f2455a4c69ec181a05acc2a2975ff61d3b5f3
